subject: Recap: Elmwood Health private-hosting needs & POC next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Ng <alyssa@elmwoodhealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@medops.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:34:00 -0400
Subject: Recap: Elmwood Health private-hosting needs & POC next steps

Hi Alyssa / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a concise recap from our discovery call and the proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Please flag anything I missed or that needs to be clarified.

TL;DR: Elmwood needs a private/VPC deployment option that meets HIPAA and FIPS-style controls, supports customer-managed keys, and can run in an air-gapped staging environment for a short PoC.

Key pain points raised
- Data residency and auditability: production PHI must never leave Elmwood-managed VPCs; strict logging/audit trail required.
- Key ownership: customer-managed KMS with key rotation and HSM-backed KEKs is mandatory.
- Network restrictions: no outbound internet egress allowed from the production cluster; limited egress permitted from a locked staging environment for initial validation.
- Regulatory evidence: SOC 2 artifacts and a penetration test report will be required for procurement.
- Cost predictability: finance needs a baseline reserved pricing estimate for 12 months.

Current Elmwood stack (from call)
- Primary infra: AWS (us-east-1) running EKS for application workloads
- Identity: Okta SSO; auditing through Elastic stack
- Storage: S3 with encryption-at-rest managed by Elmwood KMS

Success criteria for PoC
- Run inference in Elmwood-managed VPC with no outbound internet from the production subnet.
- Use Elmwood KMS for all encryption at rest / in-transit where applicable (integration via customer HSM/KMS).
- Demonstrate end-to-end request tracing and audit logs for 7 days to validate retention and access controls.
- Latency < 120ms p95 for 512-token sequences in the staging environment.

Technical constraints we captured
- FIPS 140-2 or equivalent crypto profile required for key handling.
- Allowlist-only egress: we will need specific IPs/DNS to be permitted for startup/updates (detailed list required).
- Offline/air-gapped option: Elmwood wants the ability to run an air-gapped staging cluster for validation; updates will be delivered via signed artifacts.

Deliverables we will provide
- Redwood: a short design note describing the proposed VPC architecture, KMS integration pattern, and required security controls (ETA: 3 business days).
- Elmwood: answers to the attached network questions worksheet and the list of people who will be in the PoC test window.

Proposed next steps (owners & dates)
1) Redwood to send an architecture brief + integration checklist — owner: me (Stephanie) — due: 2027-08-12.
2) Elmwood to complete "elmwood-network-questions.xlsx" and confirm the staging cluster window — owner: Alyssa — due: 2027-08-13.
3) Technical sync (Redwood infra + Elmwood network/security) — propose 60 min week of 2027-08-16; target: finalize egress allowlist and KMS handshake details — owner: Vivek.
4) PoC kickoff in Elmwood staging (air-gapped variant) — target week of 2027-08-23 — owner: Carlos.

Attachments referenced
- [Attachment: elmwood-network-questions.xlsx (xlsx)]
- [Attachment: redwood-private-poa.pdf (pdf) — short point-of-authorization outline]

Open questions we still need answered
- Which HSM/KMS vendor & key policies (key rotation windows, who controls rotation) will Elmwood enforce?
- Will Elmwood allow a small controlled egress channel for image updates during the PoC, or must those be delivered via signed bundle?

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the architecture brief shortly.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 12:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: Elmwood Health private-hosting needs & POC next steps

Thanks Stephanie — this matches our notes and is super helpful. A couple quick clarifications from my side: 

- FIPS requirement: correct — our security team requires a FIPS-compliant crypto profile for the KMS integration. We use Thales Luna for HSM in prod; staging can use AWS CloudHSM but must mirror rotation policies.
- Offline delivery: we would prefer updates via signed artifact bundles for the air-gapped staging cluster. Small, controlled egress may be allowed for the PoC if we can allowlist only Redwood's build servers — we will confirm exact IPs.
- Backup & retention: Elmwood requires encrypted offsite backups with customer-managed keys and compliance-level retention (7 years for certain clinical records).

We are available for a deep technical sync on Tue 2027-08-17 in the morning (EST) — does that work for your infra folks?

Also looping in Carlos from our platform team to help scope the staging cluster window.

Thanks,
Alyssa Ng
Head of Platform Engineering | Elmwood Health
alyssa@elmwoodhealth.com
(212) 555-0122
